description: A man in a black coat, white cravat and grey powdered wig stands at centre, pointing at a tall stack of metal discs on a wooden table with a thin wire and a small spark. Around him, astonished onlookers in 18th-century dress (a pale blue gown, brocade and velvet coats, a man in spectacles) crowd in a candlelit panelled room with dark drapes. There is no frame, gore or text apart from a small sparkle logo in the bottom right corner.
reason: Shows an 18th-century demonstration of an electric battery to wigged onlookers in Georgian dress, but the card is Simon de Montfort's 1265 Parliament. Paint a 13th-century English assembly of nobles, clergy and commoners in medieval dress and a hall.
